_readme: S697 (worker piles2), Clovis's reconcile_steps lever (26). The 2026-2027 catalog PDF's program pages for the records whose blocks sum unequal to the printed total and whose notes say the printed total and the listed courses disagree: Medical Office Administration 37352 (p.141), Information Systems -- Networking 33493 (p.132), Data Science 44551 (p.112), Music AA-T 42706 (p.175), Political Science AA-T 35209 (p.181), Occupational Therapy Assistant 39539 (pp.144-145) and Nutrition and Dietetics AS-T 43015 (p.176). Each heading is matched in capitals, so a body line naming the subject does not spend the cap. The page after each is printed, for a list that runs on. No model call.
